title: Cristaux (1970). Gribouillis et calculs divers : notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
This page is not a Grothendieck crystalline note. It is page 37.1 of a typescript, in French, with handwritten editorial corrections. It belongs to the proof of the proper base change theorem for étale cohomology in degrees 0 and 1 with possibly non-commutative coefficients. That is the theorem of SGA 4 Exposé XII (M. Artin), Théorème 5.1: for f: X→S proper with S strictly henselian local and closed fibre X_o, (i) H^0(X,F)→H^0(X_o,F_o) is bijective for any sheaf of sets F, and (ii) H^1(X,F)→H^1(X_o,F_o) is bijective for any sheaf of ind-finite groups F.

First paragraph: end of the H^0 (surjectivity) step.
- An embedding F ↪ G = h_*h^*F × π_*π^*F is given, where h: Y→X and π: X̄→X are auxiliary proper morphisms. The vertical maps in a comparison diagram are injective (6.6).
- So α_o∈H^0(X_o,F_o) lifts iff its image in H^0(X_o,G_o) lifts.
- g^* and H^0 commute with finite products, so it suffices to lift the two components.
- The h-component lifts by hypothesis (induction).
- Applying (5.1)(i) to the composites (g,π,·) and (g,f̄,·) gives H^0(X,π_*π^*F) ≅ H^0(X_o,(π_*π^*F)_o), so the π-component lifts too. A marginal note says 'un peu bref, faire l'argument'.

Second paragraph: start of the H^1 step.
- Assume (i) in general and (ii) for projective morphisms.
- Take F a sheaf of ind-finite groups and consider H^1(X,F) →u H^1(Y,h^*F) →v H^1(X_o,F_o).
- By (6.1), vu is injective, hence u is injective; it remains to show surjectivity of u.
- Given α_o coming from α*∈H^1(Y,h^*F), use (8.2(ii)) for f_Y: Y→S to find an injection h^*F→G* that kills the image of α_o in H^1(X_o,G*_o). This is the standard 'effacement' of H^1 classes by embedding into a suitable sheaf.
- Then introduce j: X'→X, the reduced image of π: X̄→X (a closed subscheme), and a sheaf F' on it; the argument continues on the next page.

Overall this is the dévissage/Chow-lemma reduction from proper to projective morphisms in the proof of proper base change. It has no relation to the crystal/F-V material on the neighbouring pages; it is evidently a misfiled typescript sheet.
errors: Typo in the typescript: 'si relève' should be 'se relève'.

The marginal annotation itself flags the H^0 argument as too brief ('un peu bref, faire l'argument'). The gap is expository only: one must say why the h-component lifts and how (5.1)(i) applied to the composites gives the isomorphism for π_*π^*F.

ideas.what: Proper base change in degrees 0 and 1 for sheaves of sets and of ind-finite groups (non-abelian H^1)
ideas.modern_name: Proper base change theorem (non-abelian low-degree form)
ideas.usually_credited_to: M. Artin (SGA 4 Exp. XII), building on Grothendieck

ideas.what: Reduction from proper to projective morphisms via an embedding F ↪ h_*h^*F × π_*π^*F and induction
ideas.modern_name: Chow's lemma / dévissage in proper base change

ideas.what: Killing an H^1 class by an injection into a larger sheaf G*
ideas.where_published: SGA 4 XII (lemma cited as 8.2(ii) in this draft)

deep.surprise_reason: This is a typescript draft page of the published proof of proper base change (SGA 4 XII), with editorial marginalia, misfiled in the 'Cristaux' folder. The only point of interest is archival: evidence of Grothendieck's (or an editor's) editing of Artin's exposé. It contains no new mathematics.
transcription_corrections: 'si relève' is in the original (a typo for 'se relève'); it is not an OCR error.
The handwritten reference '(8.2 (ii))' replaces a typed reference.
The handwritten '(5.1.(i))' after 'dans ce cas' is a marginal insertion; 'le cas' is corrected to 'ce cas'.
The marginal note reads 'un peu bref, faire l'argument'.
The handwritten addition after 'soit nulle' reads '(avec la structure induite)'.
The handwritten 'dex' near 'fermé' is probably 'de X'.
The first map's source is H^1(X,F); the typed 'H^h' is overstruck to read H^1.
